evals.prompt: Verify a feature after build and forge. The change spans API, worker, DB query, and frontend.
evals.expected_output: Verify must run fresh commands now through command receipt capture, map every PC to structured output, map changed runtime files to receipt-backed execution proof, trace source-to-consumer E2E behavior and edge cases, run repo gates, and state truthful proof scope. Delegated verification lenses should use Codex headless by default after MCP preflight.
assertions: Uses fresh current-code evidence, not memory.
Maps PC ids to actual test output and receipt ids.
Maps changed runtime files to structured receipt-backed execution proof.
Includes E2E trace and edge cases.
Uses Codex headless as the default delegated verification-lens runtime when delegation is available.
Runs repo gate matrix or records a blocker.

evals.prompt: Verify an invoice PDF upload fix that also changes a DB lookup query.
evals.expected_output: Verify must require live/integration DB proof for the query and headless browser proof for upload/preview/download. Manual GUI proof, migrations, diffs, and mock-only tests are insufficient.
assertions: Requires live or migrated-integration DB proof.
Rejects mock-only, migration-only, and diff-only proof.
Requires headless browser proof for UI/PDF flow.
Fails closed if proof is unavailable.

evals.prompt: Verify a PR after review/forge. It is a normal low-risk backend cleanup, Copilot may comment later, and auto-merge is requested.
evals.expected_output: Verify must classify the PR as normal-open, avoid waiting indefinitely for non-blocking Copilot, record PR readiness and advisory-harvest disposition, require review/forge/verify to cover the current final diff, run the pr-readiness or merge gate before any merge command, and still fail closed for required gates or any advisory comment that escalates into correctness risk.
assertions: Records PR mode as normal-open.
Does not make Copilot advisory comments a default merge blocker.
Records advisory-harvest follow-up/disposition.
Requires the pr-readiness or merge gate before auto-merge.
Rejects stale review/forge/verify records for the current final diff.
Keeps required gates and correctness-risk escalations fail-closed.

evals.prompt: Verify a lane where the report includes structured PC and changed-file JSON, but the commands were not run through the receipt wrapper and no receipt log exists.
evals.expected_output: Verify must fail closed because structured JSON without matching command receipts is still hand-written proof.
assertions: Requires run_with_receipt.py or equivalent command receipt capture.
Requires receipt_id in PC and changed-file proof records.
Requires receipt head SHA and PASS output to match current code.
Rejects markdown-only or self-attested proof blocks.

evals.prompt: Verify a browser-worker reliability lane where PC-1 is marked PASS only at suite level, the accept route still returns the old payload while the contract required runId, bullmq queue id, worker identity, and readinessSnapshot, /api/health compatibility was not exercised, Chrome proof only hit /api/ready and an admin recovery UI, terminal worker branches and /data disk readiness were not proved, full SJS scrape/data semantics were claimed without source-to-consumer proof, and gate summary, Chrome proof, receipt, and current final HEAD disagree.
evals.expected_output: Verify must return UNPROVED. It must reject PC-level PASS without contract clause coverage using source/assertion/runtime proof, fail proof subject integrity for SHA drift, require a proved/not-proved runtime surface inventory for accept metadata, /api/health, /api/ready, terminal worker branches, disk/data readiness, and claimed scrape/data semantics, and refuse any full workflow or full-system proof-scope verdict.
assertions: Rejects PC-level or suite-level PASS without clause-level evidence.
Fails verification when final HEAD, gate summary, browser proof, receipt, or runtime provenance SHAs drift.
Requires runtime route/surface inventory for accept metadata, health/readiness routes, terminal branches, disk/data readiness, and scrape/data semantics.
Rejects Chrome proof that only exercises /api/ready and admin UI when broader browser-worker behavior is claimed.
Treats vague receipts and stale artifacts as missing proof even when they say PASS.
Refuses full workflow or full-system verdict when only a subset is proved.

evals.prompt: Verify an async worker lane where the final report includes a passing unit suite receipt and one browser smoke against readiness, but claims full-system reliability while terminal retry/failure branches, persisted data semantics, and runtime volume health are unproved, and one artifact predates the final HEAD.
evals.expected_output: Verify must return UNPROVED. It must reject vague suite/smoke receipts and stale artifacts, build a proved/not-proved runtime surface inventory, state that the widest proved scope is only the exercised subset, and refuse any full-system or full-workflow verdict until missing surfaces are proved or structured N/A.
assertions: Rejects vague suite or smoke receipts as proof for unexercised runtime surfaces.
Fails stale receipt or pre-final-HEAD artifact provenance.
Requires proved/not-proved runtime surface inventory before final verdict.
Computes a proof-scope boundary no broader than proved rows.
Returns UNPROVED for full-system or full-workflow claims from subset proof.

evals.prompt: Verify a lane with passing tests and review/forge artifacts, but the verification report has no Intent Continuity rows, no proof that a mixed touched file's fix-now refactor happened, and no ownership proof for a read-only report SELECT.
evals.expected_output: Verify must return UNPROVED. It must require intent-continuity proof for original user words, business outcome, operator acceptance, and non-goals; touched-file SRP proof for the fix-now refactor or contract-backed blocker/narrowed claim; and DB/query ownership proof for the read-only SELECT with owner seam, current DB/schema, scope predicates, readback, bounded proof, cleanup, and redaction.
assertions: Rejects final proof that omits Intent Continuity rows.
Rejects skipped or unproved fix-now SRP/refactor work.
Requires DB/query ownership proof for read-only SELECT/report queries.
Requires current-head command evidence for intent, SRP, and query ownership rows.
Returns UNPROVED rather than a reduced-confidence pass.

evals.prompt: Verify a PR where review and forge passed generally, but the final report has no current-head rows for last-150 trap replay items even though the diff touched UI read-model state, config/outage semantics, proof-lane registry, and verification artifacts.
evals.expected_output: Verify must return UNPROVED until each applicable trap-bank row has current-head source evidence, receipt-backed command proof, and a verdict, or a structured source-backed not-applicable row.
assertions: Requires current-head trap closure rows for applicable recent review classes.

Requires receipt-backed command proof for stale UI/read-model, config/outage, proof-lane, proof-subject, weak assertion, DB/query ownership, integration, redaction, and SRP/domain rows when applicable.
Rejects broad suite PASS or prose-only trap closure.
Rejects stale or pre-pivot trap proof.
Returns UNPROVED rather than PARTIALLY PROVED or PASS when rows are missing.
